texts.facts: ORDER The petitioners contends that they have established an industry for packaging drinking water after obtaining necessary permission from the Competent Authorities. The 3rd respondent issued notices at Annexures-Q and Q1 dated 22.3.2012 and 30.3.2012 pointing out certain violations of the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the Regulations made therein, while packing the water. Petitioners have filed objections to the said notices as per Annexure-R dated 17.7.2012. It is further submitted that the point in issue is covered by the decision of the Division Bench of this Court in W.P.Nos.17713/2012 and other connected matters disposed of on 9.11.2012. 3.
texts.arguments: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the 3rd respondent is likely to take coercive steps for closing the industry without considering the representation.
